processes.name: Data Room Access
processes.description: Grant a colleague or counterparty access to a project virtual data room, including folder-level permissions and NDA verification.
processes.keywords: data room, dataroom, virtual data room, vdr, deal documents, project access, folder access, diligence documents, deal folder, project falcon

processes.name: Invoice Approval
processes.description: Approve a supplier invoice for payment once goods or services are confirmed received.
processes.keywords: invoice, approve invoice, supplier payment, pay invoice, billing, accounts payable, ap, invoice sign off, payment run

processes.name: IT Access Provisioning
processes.description: Provision system access, licences or shared drive permissions for a colleague, including password resets and locked accounts.
processes.keywords: access, permissions, system access, provisioning, licence, license, vpn access, shared drive, new account, joiner setup, password, reset password, locked out, mfa, login issue, cannot log in, account locked

processes.name: Travel Approval
processes.description: Approve business travel and book flights, hotels and ground transport.
processes.keywords: travel, flight, flights, trip, hotel, business travel, travel request, itinerary, travel booking, visa

processes.name: Expense Reimbursement
processes.description: Reimburse out-of-pocket business expenses against submitted receipts.
processes.keywords: expense, expenses, reimbursement, reimburse, claim, receipts, out of pocket, expense report, mileage

processes.name: Valuation Sign-off
processes.description: Quarterly fair-value sign-off for portfolio holdings feeding the NAV.
processes.keywords: valuation, nav, fair value, portfolio valuation, sign off, mark, quarterly valuation, pricing, net asset value

processes.name: Purchase Order Approval
processes.description: Raise and approve a purchase order before committing firm spend.
processes.keywords: purchase order, po, raise po, procurement request, spend approval, commit spend, buy, order form

processes.name: Policy Exception Approval
processes.description: Approve a documented deviation from an internal policy, with rationale and expiry.
processes.keywords: policy exception, waiver, exemption, deviation, override, policy breach, one off approval, dispensation
